dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, is Wat Arun worth visiting?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ˈwɑːt əˈruːn ˈwɜːrθ ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's a must-see! It's a famous landmark, and it looks amazing at sunset.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ə ˈmʌst ˌsiː! ɪts ə ˈfeɪməs ˈlændmɑːrk, ənd ɪt ˈlʊks əˈmeɪzɪŋ ət ˈsʌnsɛt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. What about the big shopping malls?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈbɪɡ ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ˈmɔːlz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Honestly, they aren't worth the time. They're like malls in Australia.
dialogue.reading: ˈɑːnɪstli, ðeɪ ˈɑːrənt ˈwɜːrθ ðə ˈtaɪm. ðɛr laɪk ˈmɔːlz ɪn ɔːˈstreɪljə.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. I also want to take a day trip from Bangkok. Any ideas?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈteɪk ə ˈdeɪ ˌtrɪp frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk. ˈɛni aɪˈdiːəz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Take the train to Kanchanaburi. The ride is really scenic, with rivers and mountains.
dialogue.reading: ˈteɪk ðə ˈtreɪn tə ˌkɑːntʃənəˈbʊri. ðə ˈraɪd ɪz ˈriːli ˈsiːnɪk, wɪð ˈrɪvərz ənd ˈmaʊntənz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is it worth staying there for a night?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈwɜːrθ ˈsteɪɪŋ ˈðɛr fər ə ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's worth it. It's the off-season now, so hotels are cheap.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈwɜːrθ ɪt. ɪts ði ˈɔːf ˌsiːzən ˈnaʊ, soʊ hoʊˈtɛlz ər ˈtʃiːp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: ˈwaɪ ɪz ɪt ði ˈɔːf ˌsiːzən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Because it's the rainy season. But it usually only rains in the afternoon.
dialogue.reading: bɪˈkɔːz ɪts ðə ˈreɪni ˌsiːzən. bʌt ɪt ˈjuːʒuəli ˈoʊnli ˈreɪnz ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I don't mind a little rain!
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈmaɪnd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈreɪn!
